stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रीकृष्ण त्वत्पदोपासनमभयतमं बद्धमिथ्यार्थदृष्टे-
-र्मर्त्यस्यार्तस्य मन्ये व्यपसरति भयं येन सर्वात्मनैव ।
यत्तावत्त्वत् प्रणीतानिह भजनविधीनास्थितो मोहमार्गे
धावन्नप्यावृताक्षः स्खलति न कुहचिद्देवदेवाखिलात्मन् ॥ ९१-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: For those who are attached to the material world, which are illusory in nature, the only way to expel their fear of death, is to surrender, serve and worship the lotus feet of Bhagwan Krishna, the God of all gods and the soul of all beings in the world. A person who is steady in Bhagwan’s devotion will not slip or falter even a little bit even if he runs on the path of delusion with his eyes closed.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śrīkṛṣṇa tvatpadopāsanamabhayatamaṃ baddhamithyārthadṛṣṭe-
-rmartyasyārtasya manye vyapasarati bhayaṃ yena sarvātmanaiva |
yattāvattvat praṇītāniha bhajanavidhīnāsthito mohamārge
dhāvannapyāvṛtākṣaḥ skhalati na kuhaciddevadevākhilātman || 91-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूमन् कायेन वाचा मुहुरपि मनसा त्वद्बलप्रेरितात्मा
यद्यत्कुर्वे समस्तं तदिह परतरे त्वय्यसावर्पयामि ।
जात्यापीह श्वपाकस्त्वयि निहितमनः कर्मवागिन्द्रियार्थ-
-प्राणो विश्वं पुनीते न तु विमुखमनास्त्वत्पदाद्विप्रवर्यः ॥ ९१-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri surrendered his body, speech and mind and the actions done out of them at the feet of the Supreme Lord. One who surrenders his actions, speech, senses and vital energies at Bhagwan’s feet, even if he is born out of a lower Varna, he will purify this world. It is not so in the case of person born as Brahmin but is indifferent towards Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūman kāyena vācā muhurapi manasā tvadbalapreritātmā
yadyatkurve samastaṃ tadiha paratare tvayyasāvarpayāmi |
jātyāpīha śvapākastvayi nihitamanaḥ karmavāgindriyārtha-
-prāṇo viśvaṃ punīte na tu vimukhamanāstvatpadādvipravaryaḥ || 91-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भीतिर्नाम द्वितीयाद्भवति ननु मनःकल्पितं च द्वितीयं
तेनैक्याभ्यासशीलो हृदयमिह यथाशक्ति बुद्ध्या निरुन्ध्याम् ।
मायाविद्धे तु तस्मिन् पुनरपि न तथा भाति मायाधिनाथं
तं त्वां भक्त्या महत्या सततमनुभजन्नीश भीतिं विजह्याम् ॥ ९१-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The feeling of fear arises from the consciousness of a second entity-different from oneself which is a projection of the mind. Bhattathiri says that he will try to control my mind with effort and discriminative intelligence.But when this is overpowered and inflicted by Maaya, the consciousness of oneness does not reveal itself again. Therefore, by constantly worshipping Bhagwan with great Bhakti, I will overcome all fear.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhītirnāma dvitīyādbhavati nanu manaḥkalpitaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ
tenaikyābhyāsaśīlo hṛdayamiha yathāśakti buddhyā nirundhyām |
māyāviddhe tu tasmin punarapi na tathā bhāti māyādhināthaṃ
taṃ tvāṃ bhaktyā mahatyā satatamanubhajannīśa bhītiṃ vijahyām || 91-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भक्तेरुत्पत्तिवृद्धी तव चरणजुषां सङ्गमेनैव पुंसा-
-मासाद्ये पुण्यभाजां श्रिय इव जगति श्रीमतां सङ्गमेन ।
तत्सङ्गो देव भूयान्मम खलु सततं तन्मुखादुन्मिषद्भि-
-स्त्वन्माहात्म्यप्रकारैर्भवति च सुदृढा भक्तिरुद्धूतपापा ॥ ९१-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Association with devotees, who hold on Bhagwan’s feet generates and grows more devotion. Bhattathiri prayed to Krishna to grant him more association with such devotees. Hearing Bhagwan’s glories and narration of his pastimes through devotees, one can attain firm and intense devotion which can ward off sins.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhakterutpattivṛddhī tava caraṇajuṣāṃ saṅgamenaiva puṃsā-
-māsādye puṇyabhājāṃ śriya iva jagati śrīmatāṃ saṅgamena |
tatsaṅgo deva bhūyānmama khalu satataṃ tanmukhādunmiṣadbhi-
-stvanmāhātmyaprakārairbhavati ca sudṛḍhā bhaktiruddhūtapāpā || 91-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
श्रेयोमार्गेषु भक्तावधिकबहुमतिर्जन्मकर्माणि भूयो
गायन् क्षेमाणि नामान्यपि तदुभयतः प्रद्रुतं प्रद्रुतात्मा ।
उद्यद्धासः कदाचित् कुहचिदपि रुदन् क्वापि गर्जन् प्रगाय-
-न्नुन्मादीव प्रनृत्यन्नयि कुरु करुणां लोकबाह्यश्चरेयम् ॥ ९१-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Among the many paths of liberation, the path of devotion - BHAKTHI is the most preferred in any form like listening to stories of Bhagwan’s various incarnations, pastimes, chanting HIS different names, singing them happily, melting with tears and sometimes shouting them out in ecstasy. Bhattathiri requested that he may be granted mercy through the path of BHAKTHI so that he could live in this world free from all inhibitions and attachments.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
śreyomārgeṣu bhaktāvadhikabahumatirjanmakarmāṇi bhūyo
gāyan kṣemāṇi nāmānyapi tadubhayataḥ pradrutaṃ pradrutātmā |
udyaddhāsaḥ kadācit kuhacidapi rudan kvāpi garjan pragāya-
-nnunmādīva pranṛtyannayi kuru karuṇāṃ lokabāhyaścareyam || 91-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूतान्येतानि भूतात्मकमपि सकलं पक्षिमत्स्यान् मृगादीन्
मर्त्यान् मित्राणि शत्रूनपि यमितमतिस्त्वन्मयान्यानमानि ।
त्वत्सेवायां हि सिद्ध्येन्मम तव कृपया भक्तिदार्ढ्यं विराग-
-स्त्वत्तत्त्वस्यावबोधोऽपि च भुवनपते यत्नभेदं विनैव ॥ ९१-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri saluted the five elements of nature and the world created out of them, the birds, fishes, animal species, human beings who live in it, friends & enemies with devotion and balanced mind as they are all forms of Bhagwan only. He believes that firm devotion, dispassion and knowledge of the supreme Paramatma are obtained automatically, by worshipping and serving Bhagwan constantly.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūtānyetāni bhūtātmakamapi sakalaṃ pakṣimatsyān mṛgādīn
martyān mitrāṇi śatrūnapi yamitamatistvanmayānyānamāni |
tvatsevāyāṃ hi siddhyenmama tava kṛpayā bhaktidārḍhyaṃ virāga-
-stvattattvasyāvabodho’pi ca bhuvanapate yatnabhedaṃ vinaiva || 91-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
नो मुह्यन् क्षुत्तृडाद्यैर्भवसरणिभवैस्त्वन्निलीनाशयत्वा-
-च्चिन्तासातत्यशाली निमिषलवमपि त्वत्पदादप्रकम्पः ।
इष्टानिष्टेषु तुष्टिव्यसनविरहितो मायिकत्वावबोधा-
-ज्ज्योत्स्नाभिस्त्वन्नखेन्दोरधिकशिशिरितेनात्मना सञ्चरेयम् ॥ ९१-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: By focussing on the Supreme Lord, Bhattathiri does not experience thirst or hunger, likes or dislikes. He wanted to nurture on the thought that everything is Maya and hence liked to be free of happiness or sadness. He wanted to practice the balanced state of mind always and keep his mind as cool as the moon of Krishna’s toe nails.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
no muhyan kṣuttṛḍādyairbhavasaraṇibhavaistvannilīnāśayatvā-
-ccintāsātatyaśālī nimiṣalavamapi tvatpadādaprakampaḥ |
iṣṭāniṣṭeṣu tuṣṭivyasanavirahito māyikatvāvabodhā-
-jjyotsnābhistvannakhendoradhikaśiśiritenātmanā sañcareyam || 91-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूतेष्वेषु त्वदैक्यस्मृतिसमधिगतौ नाधिकारोऽधुना चे-
-त्त्वत् प्रेम त्वत्कमैत्री जडमतिषु कृपा द्विट्सु भूयादुपेक्षा ।
अर्चायां वा समर्चाकुतुकमुरुतरश्रद्धया वर्धतां मे
त्वत्संसेवी तथापि द्रुतमुपलभते भक्तलोकोत्तमत्वम् ॥ ९१-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: It may be that Bhattathiri do not deserve now the experience of the knowledge of Bhagwan’s oneness with all beings. May Bhattathiri have love for Bhagwan and friendliness for devotees, kindness for the ignorant, indifference towards the enemies. Or may he have the eagerness to worship Bhagwan idol with full faith. People who worship Bhagwan in such a manner will attain the highest pinnacle of divine love.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūteṣveṣu tvadaikyasmṛtisamadhigatau nādhikāro’dhunā ce-
-ttvat prema tvatkamaitrī jaḍamatiṣu kṛpā dviṭsu bhūyādupekṣā |
arcāyāṃ vā samarcākutukamurutaraśraddhayā vardhatāṃ me
tvatsaṃsevī tathāpi drutamupalabhate bhaktalokottamatvam || 91-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आवृत्य त्वत्स्वरूपं क्षितिजलमरुदाद्यात्मना विक्षिपन्ती
जीवान् भूयिष्ठकर्मावलिविवशगतीन् दुःखजाले क्षिपन्ती ।
त्वन्माया माऽभिभून्मामयि भुवनपते कल्पते तत्प्रशान्त्यै
त्वत्पादे भक्तिरेवेत्यवददयि विभो सिद्धयोगी प्रबुद्धः ॥ ९१-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Supreme Bhagwan has hidden HIS true form and appears as earth, water, air and other elements in combination with Maya. The jivatmas, due to their past karmas are born again and again without having the ability to control their mind, suffering constantly due to Maya. Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan, that he may be spared from the Maya and requested only devotion to the Bhagwan’s feet by requoting the statement of a Siddha yogi, Praputtar about devotion to Bhagwan’s feet.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
āvṛtya tvatsvarūpaṃ kṣitijalamarudādyātmanā vikṣipantī
jīvān bhūyiṣṭhakarmāvalivivaśagatīn duḥkhajāle kṣipantī |
tvanmāyā mā’bhibhūnmāmayi bhuvanapate kalpate tatpraśāntyai
tvatpāde bhaktirevetyavadadayi vibho siddhayogī prabuddhaḥ || 91-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
दुःखान्यालोक्य जन्तुष्वलमुदितविवेकोऽहमाचार्यवर्या-
-ल्लब्ध्वा त्वद्रूपतत्त्वं गुणचरितकथाद्युद्भवद्भक्तिभूमा ।
मायामेनां तरित्वा परमसुखमये त्वत्पदे मोदिताहे
तस्यायं पूर्वरङ्गः पवनपुरपते नाशयाशेषरोगान् ॥ ९१-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Seeing how the people face difficulties in life, Bhattathiri requested that he gets more maturity, which will fetch him a good Guru. He would learn to realise the true form of Bhagwan and sing HIS glory and stories thereby win over the Maya and experience the eternal bliss. Staying devoted to Bhagwan is the first step. Bhattathiri prayed to Bhagwan to bless him with such a Guru so that he can win over Maya and experience the true bliss and requested relief from all his ailments.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
duḥkhānyālokya jantuṣvalamuditaviveko’hamācāryavaryā-
-llabdhvā tvadrūpatattvaṃ guṇacaritakathādyudbhavadbhaktibhūmā |
māyāmenāṃ taritvā paramasukhamaye tvatpade moditāhe
tasyāyaṃ pūrvaraṅgaḥ pavanapurapate nāśayāśeṣarogān || 91-10 ||
